# Proscenium

> Public Theater-inspired theatrical visual identity. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Wood-type condensed display, hot magenta + yellow, deep black or playbill cream. Layered, edge-to-edge, sharp corners. Voice runs theatrical and declarative.

## Use this variant for

Marketing sites, creative tools, brand-forward products, anything that wants personality over restraint.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark` (canonical). Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`. RTL: supported (tempered for non-Latin).

## Quick token reference (dark)

- bg: #0A0A0A / surface: #1A1A1A / text: #FAFAFA / border: #FAFAFA
- accent: #FF3A9F (magenta) / secondary: #FFE500 (yellow)
- radius: 0 / display: knockout / sans: trade-gothic-next

## Resources

- [Tokens](./tokens.json) / [Principles](./principles.md) / [Content](./content.md) / [Motion](./motion.md) / [i18n](./i18n.md) / [Starter prompt](./starter-prompt.md) / [Components](./components.json)

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/proscenium";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";
<ThemeProvider theme={theme} mode="dark"><YourApp /></ThemeProvider>
```
